name: Glitchy: Cute Loop
summary:
Strange things are happening in the home of the cute little animals. The Ghost Patrol wants to give everyone a donut before bedtime, but they can only do so if everything and everyone is in their proper place. However, the over-eager crew is always trying to prank Glitchy the little ghost, coming up with new tricks every day. They hide, rotate pictures, repaint the room, or rearrange the furniture.

Help Glitchy the ghost find these anomalies! During the game, look around the cute home, check every detail, and find the differences in the level. If everything is correct, help Glitchy by choosing the green door. But if you feel something is wrong, simply choose the red door. If you help Glitchy 8 times without a mistake, you’ve successfully completed the game—and Glitchy will be very happy!
